name: Dmitriy Samohin
headline: The World Benchmark for Hyper-Realistic Color & Historical Portraits
bio: Universally revered among tattooers as one of the most technically gifted realism artists to ever pick up a machine. Based in Odessa, Ukraine, Dmitriy Samohin achieves color blending, dermal depth, and texture rendering that rivals master Renaissance oil canvases. From wildlife to historical portraits, his pieces are regarded as global benchmarks.
awards: Best of Show Worldwide (Over 50+ International Conventions)
